name: Forest Deep
use: Primary brand colour. Wordmark, headlines, institutional backgrounds, body text on light grounds.

name: Ridge Green
use: Mountain tone in the logo. Secondary backgrounds, panels, charts, hover states.

name: Sun Gold
use: The sun. Single focal accent: sun disc, key numbers, buttons on dark. Never for small text on light.

name: Harmattan Ivory
use: Default light ground for documents, presentations and web. Warmer than white.

name: White
use: Reversed logo, paper white, UI surfaces.

name: Mist
use: Horizon line tone in the supplied reversed logo. Hairlines and dividers on dark grounds.

name: Canopy Green
use: Supporting green for charts, icons and illustration layers.

name: Sage
use: Light green tint for table bands, map land, background contours.

name: Charcoal
use: Darkest neutral (green-black). Cinematic backgrounds, long-form body text alternative.

name: Stone
use: Captions, metadata, footnotes, secondary UI text (passes AA on white and ivory).

name: Haze
use: Deeper ivory for cards, table headers and print panels.

name: Laterite
use: Red-earth accent drawn from Nigeria's laterite soils. Culture and heritage stories; sparingly.

name: Savannah
use: Dry-season grass and sand. Illustration layers, photo-overlay warmth, map water-free land.

name: Confluence Blue
use: River and coastline tone (Niger–Benue). Maps, routes, information graphics, digital links on light.

name: Harvest Gold
use: Accessible gold for text and icons on light grounds (AA for large text and UI on ivory).
